episodes.title: Andy Ngo & Ann Coulter LIVE: Inside the Zizian Trans Death Cult
episodes.description:
Thirteen-time bestselling author Ann Coulter joined me for a Substack-exclusive livestream to discuss my new book, The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult.

We explored the unbelievable acts committed by members of the Zizian cult as they left a trail of violence across the country, driven by an ideology of trans vengeance, militant veganism, effective altruism and a fanatical belief that they were “saving the world.”

The Zizians are a fringe example of extremism, but they fit into a larger pattern of growing trans violence that is legitimized, supported and financed by many powerful figures, organizations and institutions.

The Zizians didn’t get to where they are alone.
